title: Faberware stainless steel percolator 12 cup
text: Faberware stainless steel percolator 12 cup. Purchased this 12 Faberware stainless steel percolator coffee maker for fun Sunday mornings.  The fact that it is stainless steel makes clean up a breeze, dishwasher safe.  The bottom perfectly fits one of our back burners and within about 20 minutes (on medium) we have a delicious pot of perc'd coffee.  No one complains!  The top sports a glass perc top.  So far, it's been great. Time will tell!  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. product_metadata.title: Farberware 47053 Classic Stainless Steel Yosemite 12-Cup Coffee Percolator, 12 Cup Coffee Maker, Silver
features: Please refer to user guide or user manual or user guide (provided below in PDF) before first use
description: Brewing coffee on the stovetop extracts a fuller, richer flavor, and this Farberware 47053 Classic Stainless Steel Yosemite 12-Cup Coffee Percolator is ready to brew four to twelve cups of your favorite blends. The heavy-duty stainless steel is polished to a mirror finish for a classic touch and the sleek and traditional look fits in with any kitchen decor. A comfortable handle with iconic styling offers a confident grasp and is designed to provide a balanced grip while making coffee or pouring delicious French roasts or flavored coffee blends. A non-reactive coffee maker interior keeps water from absorbing any undesirable odors or tastes. And, with a permanent percolator filter basket, there's no need to deal with messy paper filters. A tight-fitting lid seals in heat and the sturdy, see-through glass knob lets you know when percolating begins and ends. Fully immersible and dishwasher safe, this percolator makes a great addition to any of the Farberware collections.
